roster.note: the fastest spacecraft ever launched, sent across the solar system to make the first close study of Pluto — and then of a world beyond it

roster.name: Pluto, up close
roster.note: on 14 July 2015 it flew past Pluto, revealing a young, active world of nitrogen glaciers and water-ice mountains where scientists had expected a dead ball of rock

roster.name: Arrokoth
roster.note: on New Year's Day 2019 it flew past Arrokoth, a tiny two-lobed body a billion kilometres beyond Pluto — the most distant object ever explored up close

links.l: The flyby of Arrokoth — the most distant world we've seen
